memories.title: Kalhan ki hikki
memories.story:
That day humein kalhan ki hikki  ke baare mein pata chala, aur honestly hum uss situation ko ignore kar rahe the kyunki kaafi chaos chal raha tha. Phir metro mein humein aur cheezein pata chali, aur Bharat bhai ka phone bhi metro mein chori ho gaya. Uske baad hum Delhi metro station par the.
Tab tak trip almost end ho raha tha, aur mujhe suddenly realize hua ki hum dono ne apne attachment issues ke baare mein bhi baat ki thi. Jab hum kisi se attach ho jaate hain, toh usse handle karna humare liye kaafi mushkil ho jaata hai.
Hum bas try karte rehte hain manage karne ke liye, but kabhi kabhi woh “too much” ho jaata hai at least mere liye toh definitely.
Phir humne alvida kaha, ek proper goodbye moment tha. Uske baad hum 8th March ko phir mile.
Overall, woh time honestly bahut hi achha tha Delhi ka woh phase finally uss din end hua, aur it was truly fabulous, wholesome, and genuinely great.

memories.title: Dhokla
memories.story:
But I remember that day, I gave you a dhokla box and you came the day before that, you and your father, Kaku, all came and I gave you that dhokla box. The next day we all were sitting there, we all ate that dhokla.
Everyone had different views and I told Mama. At the same day, something very crazy happened. You know, there was a panchayat that day under the Banyan tree. I remember that day also.
It was very, very, like, it is nostalgic right now. Like, can't even explain what it is going through right now in my mind, but there were a lot of things at that time.
Got to know too many things at that date, at that day and it was like, I remember the faces, I remember the state, I remember the talks, I remember everything of that day. It was like...

memories.title: Alisha's Boday
memories.story:
And there comes the 17th March, the Alisha's birthday day, there are some photos, glimpses in the phone. That was again a great day, it was very hectic day, minors wghere chal rahe the, and then we have just made a scrapbook for her.
You all are reading, I think there was a photo in which the scrapbook was, you are reading that scrapbook. We all are there, that small group of ours was there.
It was again a great day, fabulous day, especially for Alisha, and then there was a photo in this in which you are like, ki door ho with Alisha and there was a photo.
I add that, I know on this story, I would like to tell something, you guys are very cute and lovely together. You had a very great time from the 17th December, no, you are from, you are together with SIP. Oh my God, not SIP, you are together with counselling, right?
So at that day till this day, I have seen such a great friendship. I also want that this friendship would last long like this and my wishes are there and it could be always great and yeah.
